title: Te Kaikawe Tere o te Torona
intro: I te kooti o tētahi rangatira nui, i puta he tono kāore i taea, ā, he tokomaha i whakataetae ki te whakaatu i tō rātou hiranga. Heoi, ko te tangata anake e kaha ake ana tōna hononga ki te mātauranga atua i ngā pūkenga tinana katoa, ka taea te whakatutuki i te mahi, ka hura i tētahi wā ka rangona i roto i ngā tau.
clues: I roto ahau i te mahi a tētahi kīngi nui, he poropiti hoki, ā, i tū ahau i roto i tana porowhita tino whakawhirinaki.
Ehara ahau i te mea ahi, ehara hoki i te mea kaha tinana, engari i a au tetahi mea kaha rawa atu.
I te tono a te kīngi kia kawea mai he torona i tētahi whenua tawhiti, i mōhio pai ahau ki te mea me mahi.
I kōrero ahau mō ngā mōhiotanga i riro mai i ahau i te Pukapuka, ā, i mua i te taea e tetahi te tauhohe, ka whakatakotoria te torona ki te aroaro o te kingi.
Ehara i te mea nāku ake te kaha o taku mahi, engari he whakaaturanga nō Allah anake te mātauranga pono.
Ko au te tangata nāna i kawe mai te torona o te Kuīni o Hepa i roto i te kimo o te kanohi, e ai ki te tuhinga i roto i te Surah An-Naml.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Ko te tangata i mātau ki te Pukapuka
Ko te jinn kaha a Ifrit
Ko te manu hūpī a Sulayman
Poropiti a Sulaimana
Te Kuīni o Sheba
identity.answer: Ko te tangata i mātau ki te Pukapuka

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
